descriptionChirho: The proper name Rehoboam (רְחַבְעָם), son of Solomon and first king of the divided southern kingdom of Judah. The two clusters differ only in prepositional framing (nominative vs. lamed-preposition 'to Rehoboam'), not in referent: eng Rehoboam/to-Rehoboam, spa Roboam/para-Roboam, hin रहब्आम/रहब्आम-को, arb رَحُبعامُ/לִ-רָחַבְעָם, kor 르호보암-이/에게-르호보암, swa Rehoboamu/kwa-Rehoboamu. All 50 occurrences refer to the same historical individual.
